title: Potential crash on missing base_url
detail: If the supplied environ lacks the keys required to construct a Request.base_url (e.g. 'wsgi.url_scheme', 'SERVER_NAME', or 'PATH_INFO'), Request(environ).base_url will be None and urlsplit(None) raises a TypeError.

title: Missing import of _maybeDeferred_coro
detail: The code imports _maybeDeferred_coro from scrapy.utils.defer, but that name is not exported by that module. This will raise an ImportError at runtime, breaking the pipeline.
